history.content: hi. i dont really know why im here. just been feeling weird lately and cant shake it
Hey — that sounds like a hard, unsettled kind of weird. Is it more like vague, heavy, restless, or something else?

heavy i think. and kind of scared all the time? like my chest is tight. theres this work thing on monday a review meeting and i keep thinking im gonna get let go. but also honestly im just so tired of everything
That sounds like heavy fear, with your chest tight and the Monday review hanging over it. It also sounds worn down; does it feel more like pressure, or more like everything going flat?
flat i guess. like even if monday goes fine whats the point yknow. i just keep going through the motions and im so tired of all of it. nothing really feels worth it lately
That sounds really flat and worn down, with the Monday review still sitting under it. I’m also hearing that “what’s the point” piece — would you like to stay with that, or leave it here for now?
i dont really wanna get into it more tonight. im just really tired. thanks for listening tho i guess. gonna go lie down
Of course — we can leave it here. Lie down and let it be enough for tonight.
